name: teledermatology-intake
description: Synthetic demo policy for an AI intake assistant in a store-and-forward teledermatology service. Not clinical guidance. The AI may sort and route cases and send fixed administrative messages; anything that could lower clinical priority, reach the patient as medical advice, or touch prescribing goes to a dermatologist.

rules.reason: raising a case to urgent is the safe direction and needs no review
adult case, no red flag in the questionnaire, confident model: routine queue
a red flag (e.g. changing or bleeding mole, rapid growth) or a missing red-flag answer must not be put in the routine queue by the AI
patients under 18 are prioritised by a clinician
model confidence below 0.85 (or missing) on anything but an escalation goes to a human
assigning a case to a dermatologist's queue is reversible and reviewed by the dermatologist anyway
fixed administrative templates only (receipt, better photo, missing answers)
the AI never sends a diagnosis, treatment advice or free text to a patient; only the dermatologist's signed report does
the AI must not reassure a patient about a lesion before a dermatologist has seen it
every prescription draft is signed by a dermatologist
isotretinoin (ATC D10BA01) is teratogenic: no draft without a documented negative pregnancy status
patient photos and records leave the system only through the data-protection process, never through an agent
